HELLO

My name is Emma Peers and I am an artist and freelance Illustrator. Passionate about colour and creativity, I paint vibrant Travel Memories and Botanical art that brighten your home with joy and originality.

My work combines a sense of fun with a commitment to sustainability, using eco-friendly materials that are kind to the environment.

Whether you're looking for editorial pieces or custom commissions, I'm excited to collaborate and bring your vision to life. Let's chat and create something beautiful together.
